conditions.condition: a Combine drill contains usable direction changes for the primary group
conditions.detail: primary group = DL; DL have 13 drills with usable direction changes (PASS_RUSH_DRILL, FOUR_BAG_AGILITY_DRILL, FRONT_START_WAVE_DRILL_AND_LATERAL_REACTION, RUN_AND_CLUB_DRILL, BODY_CONTROL_DRILL); 118 DL players in Combine tracking. Primary group stays DL.

conditions.condition: detector precision and recall against drill geometry meet config thresholds
conditions.detail: SHORT_SHUTTLE: precision 0.991 (min 0.8), recall 0.959 (min 0.7), 2/2 cones with minimum separation 7.32 yd, 2 turns/attempt, angle error 2.6 deg (n=211); THREE_CONE_DRILL: precision 0.915 (min 0.8), recall 0.931 (min 0.7), 3/3 cones with minimum separation 1.81 yd, 3 turns/attempt, angle error 49.4 deg (n=66). Cones are estimated from one half of the attempts (event_id hash) and evaluated on the other half, so the precision figure is not circular.

conditions.condition: derived heading and speed agree with provided fields within config tolerance
conditions.detail: Combine cross-check vs provided fields: speed MAE [0.0,2.0):0.089, [2.0,4.0):0.065, [4.0,6.0):0.046, [6.0,8.0):0.032, [8.0,12.0):0.025 yd/s (worst relative error 0.022 vs tolerance 0.15); heading MAE up to 1.08 deg (tolerance 15.0); derived speed lags provided s by 0 frame(s). `dis` is NOT a distance in yards: 30*sqrt(dis) is an integer in 47.5% of attempts, i.e. dis = (whole_yards/30)^2; recovered distance is 1.36x the path inside the dis window. Tested, not assumed — the 'dis under-counts' claim cannot be confirmed or refuted until the field's definition is documented.

conditions.condition: capacity reliability >= config threshold in both settings (prereg smoother)
conditions.detail: Needs the per-player capacity parameters (Phase 3) on full game tracking; cannot be computed from a one-season row sample. WARNING from the audit's provisional proxy: split-half ICC of peak lateral acceleration is combine: 5536 turns, 508 players, median 10.0 turns/player, ICC(split-half lateral accel) -0.183 on 484 players with two turns in the same drill; game_sample: 7143 turns, 153 players, median 32.0 turns/player, ICC(split-half lateral accel) 0.255 on 147 players with two turns in the same drill. A negative Combine value for this proxy is a red flag for the Phase 3 parameter, not a verdict on it.

conditions.condition: Combine and game entry-speed ranges overlap
conditions.detail: Turn counts and entry speeds computed on the sample game data — SAMPLE DIAGNOSTIC, not a finding. Combine side is complete: DB 1179 turns/122 players, DL 2067 turns/118 players, OL 952 turns/120 players, TE 294 turns/41 players, WR 1044 turns/107 players. conditions.condition: turns per player meet the config minimum in both settings
conditions.detail: Kill-test statistics are scripted and run only on data that can answer them. Combine (complete file): combine: 5536 turns, 508 players, median 10.0 turns/player, ICC(split-half lateral accel) -0.183 on 484 players with two turns in the same drill; game_sample: 7143 turns, 153 players, median 32.0 turns/player, ICC(split-half lateral accel) 0.255 on 147 players with two turns in the same drill. The game side is a row sample, so the Combine-game correlation, the noise ceiling and the reliability verdict are PENDING FULL RUN. Smoother sensitivity of the turn count is in smoother_sensitivity.csv.

conditions.condition: outcome labels exist for the primary group with documented null semantics
conditions.detail: Outcome labels exist for DL: quick_pressure true on 405 of 23604 DL rows, null on 0.943; unblocked_pressure and time_to_pressure share the same event-record pattern. Null semantics are UNDOCUMENTED — treating null as false manufactures negatives (blockers.md B1). player_get_off vs tracking-derived onset: 1960 matched reps, 0.0% within 0.15 s. Pressure-label provenance is not documented; a tracking-derived get-off means at least one label input uses the player's own chips. Null semantics undocumented -> blocker B1.

conditions.condition: opponent IDs available for random effects
conditions.detail: No opponent/blocker assignment column exists in player_play. Columns whose names suggest one: ['pass_rushers_encountered']. `pass_rushers_encountered` is a count, not an ID. Random effects for 'assigned opponent' therefore have no data; the term must be dropped or replaced with team-game only. Logged in blockers.md.
